limits: Lower-bound development accounting: excludes parent/coordinator conversation usage and native attempts without receipts. Not a billing total. Do not amortize as zero.
recurring_cost_rule: Native task receipts include skill prompt, retrieval/tool calls and recovery. Report input and output separately, plus cached subset, wall time, local CPU and file storage.
pricing: No monetary claim without applicable rates. Cached input is a subset, reasoning output is a subset; never add subsets twice.
break_even: Only compute under explicit rates and positive per-task net benefit; unmetered setup costs prevent a complete break-even claim.
